rules.expected: For each named molecule, the submission preserves DBC-Ph/DBC-Nap identity and documents charge/multiplicity plus converged singlet S0 and S1 checks, or a truthful bounded-failure report.

For each named molecule, explicitly indexed dihedrals and molecule-specific transitions and orbital evidence support or qualify the moderate-twist interpretation; bounded failures identify the failed observable.
The final conclusion compares Ph and Nap, states whether the qualitative proposal is supported, and gives model limitations without claiming uncomputed experimental validation.
